You cancel your own dream before it even starts.

Kevin Trudeau shares a simple exercise: if money wasn't an object, what would you do? Then just start dreaming.

He says people limit themselves right away, like saying they don't want a plane because of the hassle. Kevin says to forget the how and picture a hassle-free plane that is always available.

Dream about your lifestyle, your relationships and how you want to feel inside. He says if you skip this step, nothing else really matters.

Where do you cancel your dreams too soon?
